entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: A large northern continent of Dominaria, setting of Antiquities, The Dark, Ice Age, Alliances and Coldsnap, later broken into islands.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Terisiare lies.

entities.name: The Thran
entities.description: An ancient empire that stretched across Terisiare, ultimately destroyed by Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The ruler of Phyrexia who destroyed the Thran empire.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Cruel and powerful dragons who ruled the earliest human inhabitants of Terisiare before being overthrown.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A brother of the Brothers' War, from Argive, who activated the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A brother of the Brothers' War who ruled the Fallaji Empire and destroyed Sarinth and Terisia City.

entities.name: The Brothers' War
entities.description: The devastating war between Urza and Mishra that ended with the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The device Urza activated in the last battle, obliterating Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: A large island obliterated in the last battle of the Brothers' War, to which Terisiare's elves had fled.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Homeland of Urza and Mishra, a coastal kingdom that crumbled after the war.

entities.name: Fallaji Empire
entities.description: An alliance of desert nomad tribes ruled by Mishra, nearly all killed in the Last Battle.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: One of the most ancient kingdoms and the only nation that survived the war.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: The puritanical church ruling Terisiare's city-states in the Dark, which sought to eradicate artifice and magic.

entities.name: Tivadar
entities.description: A knight from Thorn whose Knightly Order restored civilization by ending the Goblin Invasions.

entities.name: Rasputin Dreamweaver
entities.description: A wizard who aided Tivadar's Crusade.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A person from Giva Province who became an important figure of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A ruler of the Northern Wastes whose armies burned Kjeldoran villages; his fortress is Tresserhorn.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A kingdom with a rich military history that arose during the Ice Age.

entities.name: Rigida
entities.description: A supernatural race of ice-beings who took control of Almaaz in the Ice Age.

entities.name: Lady of Otaria
entities.description: She teleported the Sarpadian dwarves to Terisiare after the fall of their empire.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell that warmed the continents, melting glaciers and flooding Terisiare into an archipelago.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: The capital of Argive until the Fall of Penregon in 80 AR.

entities.name: Tresserhorn
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's fortress.

events.summary: The earliest humans overthrow their draconic masters and form a large empire based in Otaria.
events.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a large empire based in Otaria .

events.summary: The elves flee the expanding Thran empire to Argoth.
events.quote: The elves of Terisiare fled the expanding empire to the island of Argoth .
The empire was ultimately destroyed by Yawgmoth , ruler of Phyrexia .

events.summary: Argoth is obliterated when Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex in the last battle.
events.quote: Completely obliterated in the last battle of the War, when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex .

events.summary: Nearly all the Fallaji are killed in the Last Battle.
events.quote: Nearly all the Fallaji were killed in the Last Battle.

events.summary: Terisia City is destroyed by Mishra.
The Church of Tal rules the war-ravaged city-states and seeks to eradicate artifice and magic.
events.quote: the Church of Tal sought to eradicate them

events.summary: The Sarpadian dwarves are teleported to Terisiare by the Lady of Otaria after the fall of their empire.
events.quote: Later, the Sarpadian dwarves were teleported to Terisiare by the Lady of Otaria after the fall of their empire.

events.summary: Tivadar's Knightly Order, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, restores civilization by throwing back the Goblin Invasions, ending the Dark.
events.quote: He and his Knightly Order, aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver , temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare by throwing back the Goblin Invasions with their Crusade.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl's armies burn the village of Breway.
events.quote: Breway - a small village, put to the torch by Lim-Dûl 's armies

events.summary: The World Spell warms the continents, flooding Terisiare into the Terisian Isles.
events.quote: When the World Spell warmed the continents, melting the old glaciers, Terisiare was flooded and broke apart into smaller islands.

relations.quote: The empire was ultimately destroyed by Yawgmoth , ruler of Phyrexia .

relations.note: ruled the alliance of desert tribes
relations.quote: a great alliance of several different tribes of desert nomads ruled by Mishra

relations.note: homeland of Urza and Mishra; Urza was all but given the powers of king
relations.quote: Ruled by a monarchy until the outbreak of the War, where Urza was all but given the powers of the king.
He and his Knightly Order, aided by the wizard Rasputin Dreamweaver , temporarily restored civilization to Terisiare by throwing back the Goblin Invasions with their Crusade.

relations.note: the brothers of the Brothers' War

rejected.summary: Glaciers create a land bridge between Terisiare and Northland during the Ice Age.
rejected.quote: During the Ice Age, glaciers created a land bridge between Terisiare and the polar continent known as Northland .
